****Your role and responsibilities****
 In this role, you will join ABB's Industrial Automation Digital organization as a Domain Engineer, contributing to the development of next\\-generation industrial automation products.

* Develop reusable engineering assets including function block libraries, templates, standard sequences, and configurable automation modules to improve product quality and engineering efficiency.
* Translate domain knowledge from Food \\& Beverage, Chemical, Refinery, Oil \\& Gas, or similar process industries into scalable automation functionality and product features.

* Participate in requirement analysis, solution design, architecture discussions, and technical reviews to ensure high\\-quality product development.
* Execute unit, integration, and functional validation activities while performing root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions for identified issues.
* Prepare and maintain engineering documentation, including functional specifications, design documents, configuration guidelines, interface descriptions, and test reports.
* Collaborate with software developers, architects, quality engineers, and product owners in Agile development teams to deliver high\\-quality industrial automation solutions.
* Contribute to continuous product improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance performance, maintainability, diagnostics, and engineering best practices.


****Qualifications for the role****
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics, Control Systems, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 3–10 years of experience in Industrial Automation, Control Systems Engineering, or Product Development.
* Strong hands\\-on experience with IEC 61131 application programming, including Structured Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD), and Ladder Logic.
* Good understanding of PLC and DCS architecture, industrial control systems, sequencing, state logic, alarms, interlocks, diagnostics, and process control concepts.
* Experience designing reusable automation libraries, engineering templates, and modular control applications.
* Strong understanding of process industries such as Food \\& Beverage, Oil \\& Gas, Chemical, Refinery, or similar manufacturing domains.
* Experience working throughout the software development lifecycle including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and problem\\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex automation and control system challenges.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills with experience working in cross\\-functional Agile teams.
* Experience with ABB System 800xA and/or ABB Sattline systems will be considered an added advantage.


****More about us****
 ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource\\-efficient future. By connecting engineering expertise with software and digital technologies, ABB helps industries outperform while becoming leaner, cleaner, and more productive.
   

  

 The Process Automation business area automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the world's most complex industrial operations across industries including Oil \\& Gas, Chemicals, Energy, Mining, Metals, Water, Marine, Pulp \\& Paper, Food \\& Beverage, and many more. Through advanced automation, digital solutions, and lifecycle services, ABB enables customers to improve operational excellence, reliability, safety, and sustainability.
   

  

 Join ABB and be part of a global team that's shaping the future of industrial automation.
   

  

 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
